answer: Because the orchard index resolves every citation against the marble checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the harbor audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 271 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 271 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 3645 identities would post 2362 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
